exercises.question: Choose the grammar pattern that matches: "seems like; appears; looks like".

options.text: ～みたいだ
A とか B とか
A は B ほど～ありません
A は B ほど～ない

exercises.correctFeedback: Great! ～みたいだ matches "seems like; appears; looks like".
exercises.incorrectFeedback: Not quite. The correct pattern is ～みたいだ.
exercises.explanation: Used to say something looks, seems, or appears a certain way based on impression.
